verdict.rationale: Cursor publishes agent-oriented documentation in the llms.txt standard: a live-verified probe confirms cursor.com/docs/llms.txt (and cursor.com/llms.txt, llms-full.txt) return HTTP 200 with a sectioned, machine-readable index, and every doc page is also available as raw markdown at URL+'.md', explicitly enabling agents to be pointed at these docs. The Origin API additionally ships its own llms.txt/llms-full.txt. Missing for 10: no independent (non-Cursor) corroboration that third-party agents actually consume these files successfully, and no detail on llms-full.txt content completeness.
